basic_info.description: Welcome to Unit 3 at 3091 California Street on the border of San Francisco's prestigious Pacific Heights neighborhood. This wonderful collection of three condominiums offers the ultimate in luxury and sophistication. These open plan residences present a seamless blend of modern comfort and historic detail. Unit 3 is a beautiful 2 bed / 2 bath home with peek-a-boo view of the city. The bright great room features a large new kitchen that separates the living and dining areas. The primary suite is a true retreat with en-suite bath and closet. Like residence 2, this unit comes with a large unfinished attic above the unit to use as additional storage or future unit expansion (Buyer to verify). In-unit laundry, garage storage are included. Take advantage of the shared rear yard, perfect for relaxing or entertaining, or explore the neighborhood. Whether you are buying your daily groceries in Laurel Village or planning a farm to table Sunday feast at the Clement St farmers market, 3091 California features walkability to amazing local amenities. Enjoy great local shopping and dining on Sacramento and Fillmore Streets or hop on one of several local transportation lines to explore the city. A serene retreat with vibrant city lifestyle, these are the perfect homes.
